data.title: GoalGrid
data.description:
A beautiful life goal management application that displays 8 life themes and their associated 8 specific action goals in a radial grid format.

Key features:
• Radial Grid Display - Beautiful visual representation of life goals in a circular layout
• 8 Life Themes - Organized goals across different life areas (English, Software Skills, Health, Family, Work, Fitness, Mental Care, Lifestyle)
• Goal Categorization - Icons to classify different types of goals (numerical, continuous, internal, restrictions/rewards)
• Pastel Gradient Design - Aesthetically pleasing color scheme with smooth gradients
• Responsive Layout - Mobile-friendly design that adapts to all screen sizes
• Visual Hierarchy - Clear organization of goals with intuitive visual structure

Built with Next.js and TypeScript, featuring a static design focused on beautiful goal visualization.

data.title: Route Generator
data.description:
An advanced route URL generation and sharing tool using Google Maps API. Set departure, destination, and multiple waypoints to create and share routes as URLs.

Key features:
• Google Maps URL Generation - Automatically generate URLs that open in Google Maps
• Route Sharing - Save and share routes as unique URLs with others
• Route Restoration - Automatically restore routes when opening shared URLs
• Autocomplete - Powerful location input with Google Places API autocomplete
• Drag & Drop - Intuitively reorder waypoints with drag and drop functionality
• Responsive Design - Smooth UI optimized for both mobile and desktop
• Modern UI - Cool holographic effects and modern design

Built with Next.js App Router, TypeScript, and Google Maps JavaScript SDK for seamless route planning and sharing.

data.title: BizBuz
data.description:
A web application that transforms ordinary text into business terminology using OpenAI integration.

Key features:
• Three conversion tones (Normal/Gag/Extreme) powered by OpenAI
• Conversion history storage (up to 20 entries)
• Browser-based data storage
• Responsive design optimized for both desktop and mobile devices
• Real-time text transformation using OpenAI API
• Mobile-friendly interface for easy access to business terminology

A service that can be enjoyed by everyone from business professionals to students, showcasing modern AI integration techniques.

data.title: MapLibre Map Demo
data.description:
An interactive map application demo utilizing MapLibre with modern UI and diverse mapping features.

Key features:
• Marker Display - Add and manage markers at any location
• Route Display - Calculate and display routes between two points
• Map Styles - Switch between various map styles and 3D displays
• Current Location - Display user's current location on the map

Implemented with a modern glass-morphism UI design and responsive layout that adapts to all devices.

data.title: Kids Chore Tracker
data.description:
A web application for making household chores fun and rewarding for children.

Key features:
• Multiple child profiles with individual tracking
• Colorful and intuitive UI with kid-friendly icons and themes
• Celebratory confetti effects when tasks are completed
• Point history tracking for each child
• Custom chore creation and management
• Data backup and restore functionality

Utilizes local storage for data persistence, allowing offline usage without internet connection.

data.title: Portfolio Website
data.description:
This portfolio site is built using Next.js 15 and the latest React features. It features refined styling with TailwindCSS and smooth animations powered by Framer Motion.

The site is fully responsive, providing optimal viewing across all devices from mobile to desktop. It also supports toggling between dark and light modes.

The project gallery includes a filtering system that allows visitors to narrow down projects based on technologies of interest.

Moving forward, I plan to add new projects while continuously incorporating the latest web technologies.

data.title: Next.js Task Manager
data.description:
A simple but effective task management application built with Next.js and MongoDB.

Key features:
• Task Creation - Add new tasks with title, description, and priority
• Task Management - Mark tasks as complete, edit details, or delete tasks
• Filtering - Filter tasks by completion status
• Responsive Design - Works seamlessly on mobile and desktop devices

Built to demonstrate proficiency with Next.js, MongoDB integration, and modern React patterns.
